title: T1.2: Remove MCP from documentation and plugin files — strip MCP sections from README.md, install.sh, cli-reference.md; no file outside .forge/ contains "mcp-config"

text:
Acceptance: README.md MCP Server section (lines ~287-325) removed; bullet "MCP server for native AI tool integration" removed; no remaining MCP references. install.sh MCP registration section (lines ~72-127) removed; post-install hint mentioning story mcp-config removed; install script still works for binary install + git hooks. plugin/claude-code/references/cli-reference.md story mcp-config section (lines ~463-477) removed. No file in the repository (outside .forge/) contains the string "mcp-config" (case-insensitive).
